informal_statement: For every real r, the map s maps to r exp(i s/r) is continuous on the real line.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At FrontierPerimeter.lean:14-17, the source contract is `lemma continuous_unitCircleArc (r : ℝ) : Continuous (unitCircleArc r)`. The circle path is r*exp(i*s/r): s is the signed arclength parameter, not the central angle, and r is not fixed to one. The author preserves the stated radius/span assumptions and, for partition formulas, the stated index and N=0 conventions.
